# JobsLocked

> JobsLocked is an AI receptionist, booking and review service for US contractors and home-service businesses. It answers every phone call 24/7 in the business's name, books jobs straight into the contractor's live calendar, texts back missed calls within 60 seconds, replies to SMS/WhatsApp/web-form enquiries, hands real emergencies to the owner live, and asks every finished job for a Google review.

JobsLocked is a product of Antek Automation (UK-founded, serving US contractors). Plans start at $449/month, month to month, with a one-time setup fee. Contact: hello@jobslocked.com or +1 863-343-3594 — the phone line is answered by the AI receptionist itself, 24/7, so callers hear the product working.

Every plan includes the same floor: AI receptionist answering every call 24/7, live calendar booking with confirmation texts, missed-call text-back inside 60 seconds, instant SMS and WhatsApp replies, web-form leads called back within 60 seconds, a text summary of every conversation to the owner, live emergency handoff, and a review request with a direct Google link after every finished job.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jobslocked.com/): The problem (missed calls are lost jobs), how the receptionist works, what every plan includes, the three plans, and FAQ
- [Book a 15-minute call](https://jobslocked.com/book/): Booking calendar — pick a slot and hear the receptionist take a typical call
- [Privacy Policy](https://jobslocked.com/privacy/): How JobsLocked handles your information
- [Terms of Service](https://jobslocked.com/terms/): Terms governing use of the service

## Plans

- [Never Miss a Call](https://jobslocked.com/plans/never-miss-a-call/): $449/month, 300 receptionist minutes included. The full answer-and-book floor sold on its own — every call answered, every enquiry replied to, every job booked
- [Book Every Job](https://jobslocked.com/plans/book-every-job/): $649/month, 600 minutes included. Adds website chat, follow-up sequences that chase unbooked enquiries for days, existing-customer handling, and a pipeline view of every enquiry. Most chosen plan
- [Win the Job, Win the Review](https://jobslocked.com/plans/win-the-job-win-the-review/): $949/month plus a one-time website build, 1,000 minutes included. Adds replies to every Google review in the owner's voice, reputation watch, a website built around the booking flow, and a monthly report
